resources.string: Sign in with an access token from Luna (Settings → Security → New access token). Paste the token here, or tap Scan QR code.
Photos upload to Luna automatically at the times you set in Settings. Tap Upload now to upload without waiting.
On: wait for Wi-Fi that does not use mobile data. Off: use any network, including mobile data. Upload now does not wait.
On: wait until this phone is plugged in. Off: upload on battery too. Upload now does not wait.
Photos go into the folder you pick, then year and month (for example Photos/2026/08).
What drive do you want to store your photos on?
Pick the drive on Luna for your photos. You choose the folder on the next screen.
Select the folder to store your photos in:
Luna copies all photos on this phone to the folder you chose, when your Wi-Fi and charging settings allow. On Android 12 and older, it copies videos too.
Luna shows a quiet notice while it uploads, and an alert when upload stops (for example, when the access token expired). Android 12 and older does not ask for this.
Android can pause Luna in the background, so uploads can wait until you open the app. The next screen asks you to let Luna run in the background, and you can skip it.
Tap Grant. This phone asks for photos (required), then notifications and background access (optional).
Type only the folder name. You cannot type a path.
Enter a folder name, then tap Create.
A folder name cannot contain a slash, and cannot be only . or ..
Checking that Luna can save photos here…
This phone is asking for access…
On the next screen, let Luna run in the background. Then come back to Luna.
No drives found on Luna. Make sure the drive is plugged in, or ask an Admin for access to a drive.
Select a drive, then tap Continue.
Tap a folder to open it, or tap Use this folder to choose the folder you are in.
No folders here. You can still use this folder, or create a new one.
Select a drive first, then tap Continue.
You are not signed in. Tap Sign out, then sign in with an access token from Luna → Settings → Security.
Luna is uploading photos from this phone.
Tap Upload now to look for new photos.
